bind_address.description: IP address the server listens on (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces, or specific IP).

bind_port.description: TCP port for HTTP server (commonly 80 or 8080).

ip_pool_file.description: Path to a file listing client IP pools in CIDR notation (one per line).

clients_dir.description: Directory containing per-client configuration files (typically named by client IP).

out_interface.description: Network interface used for routing client traffic (must support masquerading/NAT).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent HTTP connections allowed per client.

idle_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before an idle connection is closed.

debug.description: Enable detailed logging for troubleshooting (set to true for verbose output).

rate_limits.description: List of per-client rate limits (each entry applies to a specific IP/CIDR range).

ip.description: Client IP or CIDR range (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24' or '10.0.0.5').

download.description: Maximum downstream bandwidth in kilobits per second (kbps).

upload.description: Maximum upstream bandwidth in kilobits per second (kbps).
